files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: Count how many riders joined in each calendar quarter, using joined_on and leaving out riders without a join date. `result` should be a table with the columns year, quarter (1 to 4) and n_riders, sorted by year and then quarter.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv, parse joined_on as dates, drop riders with an empty joined_on, and count riders per (calendar year, quarter 1-4) of the join date. Return a table with columns year, quarter, n_riders sorted by year then quarter ascending; only quarters with at least one join appear.

acceptable_variants.notes: quarters without joins may be shown with 0

notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
